fun plan() {
  val registry = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/plan-tools.md")
  val scopeAttempt = runCommand(listOf("rtk", "cat", "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/scope.json"))
  val changedAttempt = runCommand(listOf("rtk", "cat", "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/changed-files.txt"))
  val diffAttempt = runCommand(listOf("rtk", "cat", "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.diff"))
  val contextAttempt = runCommand(listOf("rtk", "cat", "/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json"))
  val repoReadmeAttempt = runCommand(listOf("rtk", "cat", ".repo_context/README.md"))
  val indexAttempt = runCommand(listOf("rtk", "cat", ".repo_context/index.md"))
  val maintenanceAttempt = runCommand(listOf("rtk", "cat", ".repo_context/maintenance.md"))
  val repoIndexAttempt = runCommand(listOf("rtk", "cat", ".repo_context/generated/repo_index.md"))
  val scope = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/scope.json")
  val changedFiles = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/changed-files.txt")
  val diff = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.diff")
  val taskContext = readRepoFile("/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
  val repoReadme = readRepoFile(".repo_context/README.md")
  val index = readRepoFile(".repo_context/index.md")
  val maintenance = readRepoFile(".repo_context/maintenance.md")
  val repoIndex = readRepoFile(".repo_context/generated/repo_index.md")
  val engineeringPrinciples = readRepoFile(".repo_context/modules/overview/engineering-principles.md")
  val testsReproduction = readRepoFile(".repo_context/modules/quality/tests-and-reproduction.md")
  val docsList = runCommand(listOf("find", ".", "-path", "./.git", "-prune", "-o", "(docs/readme markdown listing)"))
  val docsSearch = runCommand(listOf("rg", "-n", "dscli|cli|ping|network|worker host|worker's network|deploy", "README.md", "docs", ".repo_context", "cli"))
  val dscliDoc = readRepoFile("docs/source_zh_cn/deployment/dscli.md")
  val commandPy = readRepoFile("cli/command.py")
  val cliFiles = runCommand(listOf("find", "cli", "-maxdepth", "2", "-type", "f", "-name", "*.py"))
  val analysis = compute(scope, changedFiles, diff, taskContext, repoReadme, index, maintenance, repoIndex, engineeringPrinciples, testsReproduction, docsList, docsSearch, dscliDoc, commandPy, cliFiles)
  val evidence = compute(analysis)
  writeFile("/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", evidence)
  publish("safeoutputs/noop", "No action needed: docs preflight evidence written; no GitHub action required beyond required completion signal.")
}
